answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales linearly with capital at risk. An attacker reaching the summit of network control must acquire a majority of total supply, a cost that pushes them to the ledge of financial ruin. Any attempt to verify fake identities via a quill of false data results in slashing penalties, effectively pricing out malicious actors by tethering their digital voting power to tangible economic value rather than pseudonymous address generation.
